method.luminance: linear Rec.709 decoded from captured sRGB PNG values; no exposure or white-balance normalization
method.physicalScale: captured 450 px width / 127 mm sampled film width at the verified 1:1 B3 state
method.imageOrigin: captured Ground Glass center (225,180 px); circular masks are orientation independent; asymmetric-relief bounds use the source geometry projected about this center

roiDefinitions.outerMetallicRim: physical-radius annulus 43.6–45.0 mm from specimen center
roiDefinitions.darkCentralInset: central disk with radius 30.2 mm (source inset radius 30.8 mm minus a 0.6 mm edge margin)
roiDefinitions.centralAsymmetricReliefBounds: source-geometry bounding box |x|≤11.5 mm, |y|≤14.5 mm around the relief vertices
roiDefinitions.radialTicks: annulus 37.8–42.2 mm around the source radial tick circle at radius 40 mm
roiDefinitions.fastenersAndSlots: eight radius-2.1 mm disks around the source fastener centers on a 24.5 mm orbit
roiDefinitions.backgroundControl: fixed empty-film pixel patch x=18..51, y=18..51 from the screenshot top-left; outside the 90 mm specimen

method.localGradient: mean forward luminance gradient within the ROI; material contrast and optical blur both affect it, so it is not physical sharpness
method.comparisonLimits: one controlled visual metric for the accepted physical subject; not a photographic ground-truth score
